title: Audio devices
description: The Mac's audio devices and defaults, written by keeper/input-watch.swift on change to ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/audio/devices.json (AUDIO_DEVICES_FILE overrides). The human contract and the fresh-or-stale rule: docs/audio-devices.md. Strict here so the writer's test catches drift; readers ignore unknown fields.

version.description: Schema major version. Bumped only for a breaking change.

pid.description: The writer's process id; a dead pid means the file is stale.

started_at.description: When the writer started: seconds since the Unix epoch, 3 decimals.

written_at.description: When this file was written (a change, or a re-assert): seconds since the Unix epoch, 3 decimals. Not a heartbeat.

seq.description: 1 on this writer's first write, then up by one per write.

inputs.description: Every device with input streams, sorted by name then uid.

outputs.description: Every device with output streams, sorted by name then uid.
